name: nature_answer_fixed_asset_routes_to_asset
message: I purchased a table for Rs.25,000

history.question: Is this item: (a) a FIXED ASSET (long-term use, to be capitalised), (b) an INVENTORY-STOCKED PRODUCT (resale stock — catalog flag only, quantities are not tracked), (c) a CONSUMABLE / one-off EXPENSE (expensed immediately), or (d) a SERVICE? Please answer with a, b, c or d.
Was this paid in cash or on credit?
What is the transaction date? Reply TODAY, or the date as YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY (for example 2026-09-04 or 04/09/2026).
